verdicts.quote: opening it shows the chat page at the tab URL. … only what the user typed (plus admin-configured instructions and earlier turns of the same chat). It does **not** read or send Salesforce records.

verdicts.missing: Record-based answers are excluded. The specification gives no rule for selecting answer sources under the asking user's sharing permissions.

verdicts.missing: The specification excludes CRM reads. It gives no field-level rule for reading or displaying encrypted or restricted values.

only the person at that browser. No other user, admin or process can read it from the org by design. … a Salesforce debug log with a trace flag may capture callout request/response bodies

verdicts.missing: The design uses a synchronous UI call. It specifies neither the trigger restriction nor an asynchronous execution path for trigger-initiated work.

a Named Credential references it as the callout endpoint … Other `CalloutException` (named credential missing, endpoint not authorized, principal access missing) | `CALLOUT_FAILED`
HTTPS call (synchronous). … on success return reply text. UI: if its request token is still current, append bot message
verdicts.missing: The UI consumes the inline server result. No mechanism delivers or detects an answer completed later by a background job.

verdicts.quote: pressing Retry re-sends the same text, and on success shows exactly one user bubble and one bot bubble for it (no duplicate). … Idempotency: none; xAI is not asked to dedupe.
verdicts.missing: Duplicate suppression covers a UI retry. No message or request identity prevents a replayed job from posting a second reply.

verdicts.quote: Grok could not accept the request; ask an admin to check the model setting … HTTP 5xx | `UPSTREAM_ERROR` | Grok is having trouble; try again … `TIMEOUT` | Grok did not answer in time
HTTP 429 | `RATE_LIMITED` | Grok is busy or the key's limit is reached; try again shortly … with a **Retry** control; the product does not retry automatically.
`TIMEOUT` | Grok did not answer in time … 2xx but no assistant text parseable | `BAD_RESPONSE` | Grok returned something unreadable
verdicts.missing: The specification gives no detection or display rule for a parseable answer cut short by the provider.

verdicts.quote: the transcript exists only in the open page's memory … Message (in transcript) | Sent-answered, Not-answered (failed, retry offered), Bot reply
verdicts.missing: Only transient message states are defined. There is no conversation-and-turn record schema linking turns to timestamps, model identifiers, or usage counts.

verdicts.quote: the transcript exists only in the open page's memory (AD-4); lifetime = until New chat, page reload, or navigating away from the page.
verdicts.missing: Local retention and clearing are specified. The text does not say whether deleting the user clears a transcript still open in a browser.
